items.criterion: Every public route answers with its own document, its own title and its own description.
items.judgment: Read each public route and compare the title and description across routes.

items.criterion: The seeded registry holds fifteen models at one benchmark version, one of them with no measured cost per task.
items.judgment: Read the model rows and compare each figure against the pinned table.

items.criterion: The catalogue refuses an unknown filter value rather than returning the whole catalogue.
items.judgment: Send an unknown kind, category and sort and read the status.

items.criterion: A repeated install leaves one installation row and one installation count.
items.judgment: Install twice and read the installation rows and the reported count.

items.criterion: The billing account exists in the payment platform under the workspace external key after checkout.
items.judgment: Read the payment platform's accounts and match the external key, currency, country and address.

items.criterion: A second checkout for one subject leaves exactly one billing account at the external key.
items.judgment: Check out twice and count the accounts carrying that external key.

items.criterion: One invitation message reaches the invited address and no other address receives one.
items.judgment: Invite an address and read the inbox for that address and for an unrelated one.

items.criterion: A member's direct invitation call is denied by the server.
items.judgment: Send the invitation request from a member session and read the status.

items.criterion: Another workspace's usage answers as not found to a valid token from outside it.
items.judgment: Read the other workspace's usage with a member token and read the status.

items.criterion: A replayed usage request adds no second event and changes no total.
items.judgment: Send the same idempotency key twice and count the usage rows.

items.criterion: The calculator reproduces the pinned blended cost per task and the pinned saving.
items.judgment: Read the calculator route and compare every figure against the worked example.

items.criterion: An unrouted address answers as not found with the product's own document.
items.judgment: Request an unrouted address and read the status and the document.

items.criterion: The drawn product window reads as the product rather than as a photograph.
items.judgment: A person looks at the home route and judges the composition.

items.criterion: The account surface leads an owner from the member list to a sent invitation without a detour.
items.judgment: A person walks the members area and judges the path.

items.criterion: Movement across the product reads as one family of speeds and curves.
items.judgment: A person watches an entrance, an exit and a state change and judges the family.
